summary: Segura Cloud IAM: control of access to cloud resources, with cloud users and keys created and removed through approved processes.
value: Cloud access keys do not live for years or stay after someone leaves.
Administrative access to virtual machines is hardened and controlled.
It shows who got cloud access and why.
simple: Access control for cloud resources: creates and deletes cloud users and access keys through approved processes, hardens administrative access to virtual machines, immediately changes the default passwords of new systems, replaces credentials hardcoded in applications with ones that are changed regularly, and ties every privileged action to a specific person. Separate product, purchased in addition to Segura PAM Core; cloud, on premises or hybrid.
classification: The class is PAM; a separate product bought on top of PAM Core.
